title: Nezzy's Poggers Vanilla+
description: A vanilla+ pack that optimizes with QoL tweaks while maintaining the vanilla experience.
body:
Nezzy's Poggers is a Vanilla+ modpack designed to optimize the game with a bunch of QoL tweaks, while avoiding any mods that add extra content or overhauls. The goal is to create an experience that is as close to vanilla as possible, with added visual and auditory flair! 

The Modpack includes:
- Optimization mods including sodium, memory leak fix, etc.
- Iris Shaders, Distant Horizons with compatible shaders.
- Vanilla+ mods such as Vanilla Refresh.
- Sound and Animation mods
- Essential for easy multiplayer connections
- Includes Terrestria and Traverse for a little extra world generation 

(NOTE: World generation mods are disabled by default. Turn them on if you prefer some more biomes.)

This modpack was made primarily to enjoy the new minecraft content with my friends without need of a dedicated server. It serves as a great entry for your next minecraft adventure, or a template for your own modded experience!
